- Does Growthik Media offer refunds for digital marketing services?
- acceptedAnswer
- Growthik Media provides digital marketing and online services only. Due to the nature of digital services, returns and exchanges are not accepted. Refunds may be considered only in cases where the service has not yet been started.
- What is the cancellation policy for SEO and marketing retainers?

- Management fees for Google Ads or Meta Ads campaigns are non-refundable. Ad spend paid directly to advertising platforms cannot be refunded by Growthik Media.
